usedFor: A new Shopify blog article is scheduled or saved as a draft post in PostFast.

bestTemplate.name: “New Blog Article” in Shopify, then “Create Post” in PostFast
bestTemplate.why: A published article is worth sharing, and “Create Post” can add media and a first comment.

watchOut: “New Blog Article” is polling, so PostFast hears about it on a schedule, not instantly.
